description: Full eternity: a band set with stones around its WHOLE circumference, delegated to the Pave Engine. Locks in that the stone COUNT follows the band's own size rather than being stored, and that real retention metal holds every stone — the Pave Engine is the one layer whose settingGeometry is true.
knownLimitations: SPECIALTY_RINGS_AWAITING_PROFESSIONAL_REVIEW: every dimension in this design is a software construction parameter. No stone spacing, bead size, cluster density or stone-security judgment is asserted anywhere, and no qualified jewelry professional has reviewed this geometry. The variant's capability status is NOT_REVIEWED.

CENTRE_STONE_AND_HEAD_REMAIN: a true eternity band carries no centre stone and no head. REQUIRED_COMPONENT_NAMES includes `stone_reference` and `basket_support`, so a stone-less ring is not representable — the same blocker `plain_band` records. This baseline is therefore a stone-set band PLUS a centre stone, and says so rather than implying otherwise.
notes: Sprint 29 Specialty Rings v1: INITIAL_BASELINE for a newly executable specialty family. Created by running the real pipeline; no existing baseline was modified.
